parsed.doc_summary: Law-firm alert (Aug 21, 2026) on algorithmic rent-pricing ordinances. In-scope content: SF §37.10C, San Diego §§98.1101-98.1104, Berkeley ch. 13.63, Santa Ana NS-3090, Jersey City §218-12, Hoboken ch. 158. Other cities are out of scope.

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. The ordinance is enforced publicly and privately, with fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic rent coordination services; fines up to $2,000/day
rules.effective_date_note: Document states 'effective June 2025'; no exact day given.
rules.conflict_note: NJ FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43) may preempt this ordinance once it takes effect; not discussed in this document.

rules.title: Hoboken ban on algorithmic rent coordination
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.citation: Hoboken City Code ch. 158, Art. II
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.key_value: ban on software/algorithms/data-sharing platforms coordinating rents, lease terms or occupancy
rules.effective_date_note: Document states 'effective July 2025'; no exact day given.
rules.conflict_note: NJ FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43) may preempt this ordinance once it takes effect; not discussed in this document.

rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use qualifying algorithmic devices that use nonpublic competitor data to advise on rent or occupancy. Tenants can sue, and each unit-month may be a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits qualifying algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation, with unit/month exposure;
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; up to $1,000 per violation
rules.penalty: Damages, injunctive relief, civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation

rules.title: San Diego ban on algorithmic rent-setting
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use prohibited algorithmic rent-setting tools. Tenants can sue for damages, injunctions and penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and property potentially a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: Similar prohibition and private remedy of up to $1,000 per violation; now at issue in Keller v. UDR Inc., (S.D. Cal.).

rules.title: Berkeley ban on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use coordinated rent-pricing algorithms. Violations recur by unit and month and carry private remedies.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies,
rules.effective_date_note: Alert says January 2026; the ordinance text reportedly says March 1, 2026 (not in this document).
rules.conflict_note: Two published effective dates: January 2026 (this alert) vs. March 1, 2026 (ordinance text). The official text should be preferred.

rules.title: Santa Ana ban on automated rent price-fixing
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing tools. Tenants can sue for up to $1,000 per violation per month.
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.key_value: up to $1,000 per violation per month
rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 per violation and per month
